newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle trade at standstill - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle trade at standstill - USDA.

text.p: Trading on slaughter steers and heifers was at a standstill, as this week's showlists already well "cleaned up", USDA said. A few bids of $105.00-$106.00 per cwt on a dressed basis noted. Weekly volume 107,200.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
Slaughter Heifers - No reported sales. Sales confirmed - None For the week - None
